  - region "Simple English explanation of Attach / Detach Point":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Attach / Detach Point" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Attach binds a point to an object so it inherits that constraint; detach releases it to two free coordinates. An attached point on a circle of radius 5 cannot sit at (6,0). You can learn Attach / Detach Point by trying one small example instead of long theory.
    - paragraph: Toggle the bind, then test a point that is on the object versus a point that is not. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, maps: Attach a marker to a route. Watch out: Thinking a detached point still follows the object. Detached points move freely."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Construct Attach / Detach Point.
